name: Magician Impossible
description:
About This Game

Casting spells and invoking magical incantations normally requires years of formal training and countless permits (neither of which you have).

You've found yourself in some hot water after causing a bit of an incident, now you're on the run from the law. Use your unconventional magic to escape prison, cause minor property damage, and prove that maybe wizard school is a scam after all!

Progress through a linear story across a series of handcrafted levels, each introducing new spells and challenges as you work your way toward freedom. Discover hidden spells, steal magical gear, and find increasingly absurd ways to solve problems with magic.

The Game:

Magician Impossible is a first person puzzle platformer with light combat and spellcasting mechanics. Players draw symbols with their wand to cast spells, solve environmental puzzles, and navigate 3D levels using movement abilities like grappling and flying.

Key Features:

  • Draw to Cast - Cast spells by drawing shapes with your mouse in real time.

  • Environmental Puzzles - Solve puzzles using creative spell interactions.

  • 3D Platforming - Jump, swing, slide and glide through platforming challenges.

  • Stealth & Theft - Evade detection and steal items using magic.

  • Physics-Based Magic - Use telekinesis to grab, throw, and launch objects.

  • Upgradeable Gear - Enhance your wand and broom with magical modifiers that boost spell power, improve mobility, or just make things look cooler.

  • Boss Fights - Combine all your spells and movement abilities to fight various bosses throughout the levels.

  • Goofy Story - A lighthearted tale that doesn't take itself too seriously.

  • Original Soundtrack - A whimsical, handcrafted score composed by the developer to match every magical misstep.

Other Features:

  • Shapeshift - Squeeze through tight places or scurry past guards as a rat.

  • Fishing - Because why not?
short_desc: A first-person, spell-casting, adventure about a second rate, self taught magician who's on an impossible mission. Draw shapes with your wand to cast spells, solve puzzles, swing over chasms, and steal anything that isn't nailed down!
